fusions.name: Mycelial Draw
fusions.desc: Sends a thread of mycelium into one enemy carrying one of your afflictions, using that affliction up; it deals 9 damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Rot in the Roots
fusions.desc: Exhales a cloud of spores across a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 30 damage that ignores resistances and leaving every enemy hit [Poisoned] for 4 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Mycorrhizal Share
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 conditions from you and every ally near you, and restores 10 health to you.

fusions.name: Hyphal Mat
fusions.desc: Every ability you use builds a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 stacks they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 5% of your maximum health per stack (30% in all). A stack fades every 10 seconds if none is added.
